protocol.surface: pooled out-of-fold validation (5 folds, 66 CV patients)
protocol.held_fixed: route/k/cap/temperature/two-level ranking (D3-D7) and the gate fit protocol (pooled OOF, 5->16->3, same seed/epochs/lr)
protocol.selection_bias: every row is scored on the surface the gate is fitted on; the winner must be confirmed once on the held-out test set
